purpose: HSPICE L='equation' under LTYPE=0, the default (v = L di/dt, ngspice's L network), of its own current and of a node voltage, and under LTYPE=1 (the flux L i), with M, TC1 and DTEMP from TNOM

oracle.derivation: A current ramp i = k t (k = 1e3 A/s) through each inductor; L0 = 1m, v(ctl) = 1 + r t, r = 1e6/s. la: L = L0(1 + 500 i), v = L k. lb: la's L times 1 + 1e-3 (75 + 10 - 25) = 1.06 (Elements and Device Models E-2010.12 p. 40), M = 2 in parallel: v = 1.06 L k/2. lc: L = L0 v(ctl), LTYPE=1 holds the flux L i, v = d(L i)/dt = L0 k (1 + 2 r t). ld: the same L, default LTYPE=0: v = L k = L0 k (1 + r t). LTYPE semantics: User Guide E-2010.12 pp. 183-185; LTYPE=1's flux is the dual of CTYPE=1's charge (pp. 986-988).
oracle.corroboration: ngspice-45 (sha256 8fb8a06f1657913fc3649db67924d1e8df125b9fa27d0bf6e9bb1fb73d8ca441) .meas on this circuit written as ngspice cards (l={...} for la, lb and ld; for lc a 0 V sense source, b 0 int i=1m*v(ctl)*i(vsc), l int 0 1 and a v=v(int) B; M, TC1 and DTEMP folded into the constant), .tran 1n 2u 0 2n, agrees to 2e-06: ngspice -n -b ltype_ng2.sp
oracle.tolerance: rtol 1e-4: the transient's own discretization error, at most 3e-6 in the ngspice-45 twin with a 2 ns step cap
